job.title: Consultant E-Commerce (w/m/d)
job.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Your Consultant E-Commerce role needs someone who links customer processes and commerce technology – my daily work for 5+ years on SAP Commerce Cloud B2B platforms. What I bring in concrete terms:

– Requirements, functional specs, process mapping and UAT
– B2B catalog, pricing, promotions and OMS functionality
– SAP ERP / PIM / MDM integration with international teams

This lets me take on real responsibility in your team from day one. I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026. My CV and cover letter are attached, and I am happy to walk you through my projects in detail. Could we set up a short 15-minute call in the next few days? I look forward to hearing from you.

Kind regards
Kranti Chavan

tailoring.headline: Consultant E-Commerce | Techno-Functional | SAP Commerce Cloud B2B & Integrations
tailoring.summary: Techno-functional e-commerce consultant with 5+ years on enterprise B2B and B2C commerce (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Combines requirements engineering, stakeholder management, functional specifications, process mapping and UAT with hands-on technical depth in catalog, pricing, Order Management (OMS), headless APIs and PIM / ERP / MDM integration. Works in agile, international teams and uses AI tools in analysis and documentation. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer and Business User.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

tailoring.why_company: Bechtle is one of Europe's largest IT providers with a strong B2B e-commerce business, and consulting there directly shapes how customers buy. I want to bring my techno-functional SAP Commerce experience to that scale – and Neckarsulm is close to my home in Karlsruhe. My combination of hands-on platform depth and close work with business teams is exactly what I want to put to work for you.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello, your Consultant E-Commerce role fits my profile: 5+ years techno-functional B2B commerce on SAP Commerce Cloud (Rockwell Automation, Shell), SAP certified. Karlsruhe (close to Neckarsulm), start 16.12.2026. Open to a short call?

en.subject: Application: Consultant E-Commerce
en.hook: B2B e-commerce at Bechtle's scale depends on consultants who understand both the customer's processes and the platform underneath. That is exactly my profile: for more than five years at Rockwell Automation and Shell I have shaped B2B and B2C commerce on SAP Commerce Cloud between business and IT – certified as SAP Commerce Cloud Developer and Business User.

bullets.label: E-commerce consulting
bullets.text: Worked in a techno-functional role with business stakeholders: analysed requirements, wrote user stories and functional specifications and translated them into SAP Commerce solutions.

bullets.label: Process & requirements analysis
bullets.text: Gathered and analysed business requirements with product owners, mapped processes and supported user acceptance testing (UAT).

bullets.label: B2B catalog, pricing & orders
bullets.text: Implemented product, catalog, pricing and customer data functionality and maintained Promotions Engine and Order Management (OMS).

bullets.label: ERP & PIM integration
bullets.text: Built PIM-to-Hybris pipelines with Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub and resolved SAP ERP / MDM integration bottlenecks with international teams.

en.logistics: I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. Neckarsulm is within easy reach of Karlsruhe. I would be glad to discuss in a conversation how I can support Bechtle's e-commerce customers.
